company.shortDescription: Group Friendship Network : The Next Generation of Social Networks.
company.description:
Group Friendship Network, based on randomly linking 5 persons that have the similar age and interests in some suggested place chosen upon the closest distance among them.

They get to know each other before meeting by talking directly in a Group Chat Room which is created especially for this group after accepting the invitation.

After attending and meeting each person writes his own review about the other and everyone earns coins that can be spent inside and outside the application.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $145,656 to $145,656, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 1 (-18).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
